items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: So they got Butch Ballard. ... Basie was left without a drummer. So he told Rushing to call me. ... And so when they finished the job at the Royal Roost, they went out on the road. And they were out on the road a week, and he put his notice in and went and joined Woody Herman's band, Shadow. So Basi

ctx.x: He's a white boy, isn't he?
No, no, Ballard, he played with Cootie Williams' band, too.
